---
title: "Digital Electronics and Microcontrollers (Taller V) 2011-1"
---

This course introduces the fundamentals of digital electronics and microcontroller-based systems, including combinational and sequential logic, memory devices, embedded programming, peripherals, and final project development.
Universidad Nacional de Colombia @2011
